#   delete  stock has no use for it in this mod -- after `nm -D` of the engine binaries shows no by-name

#   live    the census premise did not hold at this tip: a compiled object imports from it. Not dead; it
#           leaves with the phase that ports its importers.
#   ported  a port or live row whose TU has since left client.so; the reason names (PORTED:) the managed
#           code that replaced it and the fact that replays stock against it.
